description: Why a Tally Prime sync failed: the latest 10 runs with created/altered/error counts and a classified failureKind (missing_ledger, missing_stock_item, missing_voucher_type, tally_unreachable, empty_push, ...), naming the missing master when Tally does. Tally reports only the first missing master per push.
name: get_tally_sync_errors
title: Tally sync errors
